parsed.rationale: The subtask is to compile a list of popular online stores that sell party supplies. Among the candidate APIs, the 'Kohls - stores/list' API is from the eCommerce domain and provides a list of stores near a GEO location, which can be used to identify popular stores selling party supplies. Other APIs are either unrelated to eCommerce or do not provide store listings. Although it requires geo-coordinates, these can be reasonably defaulted or requested from the user. Hence, this API best fits the subtask.
